purpose: replace P1-specific hard-coded material values with a structured, provenance-carrying specification that any product target can consume; geometry identity must not change when only materials change

authorities.manufacturing_barrier: no render material or rendered colour ever becomes manufacturing, masterbatch or print authority

material_specification/1.0.applies_to_component: body | closure | collar | bulb | applicator | contents | mirror | pan | case | lid | insert

material_class.fail_closed: unknown class is refused, never defaulted

finish.note: finish is a SURFACE treatment and must never silently remove transmission (P1 V2/V3 rejection lesson)

colour.value: sRGB triple or named colour reference
colour.production_colour_barrier: a render colour is NEVER a Pantone/masterbatch/print specification without its own physical authority (lab dip, drawdown, printed proof)

thickness_mm.note: wall thickness drives optical path length and therefore perceived colour

contents.why_first_class: P1 V2/V3 were rejected as 'opaque brown' because the vessel was modelled EMPTY — all colour had to come from the wall, which physically saturates toward brown/red over long optical paths. Contents are a material input, not an afterthought.

material_preset/1.0.openness_rule: presets are STARTING POINTS; an arbitrary valid specification is always accepted and never forced into a preset

mode.rule: NEUTRAL_VALIDATION uses the clay override and is the ONLY geometry-truth mode; CLIENT_PRESENTATION never validates silhouette or dimensions

scene_specification/1.0.colour_management: pinned: Standard view transform, exposure 0, gamma 1, Cycles CPU seed 0

absorption_for_target_transmission.usage: given a target transmitted RGB at a stated path length, solve absorption colour+density instead of guessing
absorption_for_target_transmission.provenance: derived during P1 V4 after tan/red failures; documented so no future target repeats the search

invariants_to_test: material_change_preserves_mesh_identity — changing any material field leaves every mesh identity byte-identical
existing P1 V1-V4 fixtures render unchanged while the generalized path is disabled
colour provenance is mandatory and never promoted to production authority
